# Embedded Signup session info fixtures (F3a)

**Not recordings from Meta.** Hand-built from the v5 session info fields in Meta's documentation (`messaging_account_ids`,
`phone_number_id`, `business_id`, `is_on_biz_app`, `primary_waac_ids`), with fake ids. They will be replaced by scrubbed
recordings from the first real connect (plan §9.5, T10). Until then they only prove our parser handles the documented shape.
